text.en: Many customers describe the shop staff as friendly, welcoming, and helpful, particularly when assisting with self-service wash tubs and boutique items. However, several pet owners experienced serious service lapses, including poor communication, employees leaving early, and a dog being left unattended in a kennel. Overall feedback indicates that while routine visits are pleasant, service reliability can be inconsistent.

Several reviewers note that their pets felt comfortable and came home calm after grooming or self-wash visits. Conversely, two clients expressed significant concern about pet neglect, citing an unattended dog forgotten in a kennel and another pet feeling rushed through bathing like a car wash. Prospective clients are advised to confirm scheduling and kennel supervision procedures when dropping off pets.

Pet parents report differing grooming results at the salon. Several reviewers were delighted with clean, fresh-smelling coats and attractive breed cuts on their dogs. In contrast, one client was deeply dissatisfied after an uneven and overly close shave that did not match the requested styling chart. Clients recommend bringing explicit grooming instructions and reference photos to ensure desired styling.

q.en: Are self-service dog wash stations available at the Babcock Road location?

a.en: Yes, the shop features self-service wash tubs equipped with warm water, towels, blow dryers, shampoos, and grooming tools.

q.en: Can clients purchase boutique pet apparel and accessories at the shop?

a.en: Yes, the facility includes a retail boutique stocked with pet clothing, collars, toys, gifts, and accessories.

q.en: Are appointments required for the self-wash stations?

a.en: No, clients report that self-service dog wash tubs are accessible on a walk-in basis without prior reservations.

q.en: Does K9 Cafe Boutique & Spa groom cats as well as dogs?

a.en: Yes, the salon offers grooming services for both dogs of all sizes and cats.
